children: Rythm entered into an amendment to its Trademark and Recipe License Agreement with GTI Core to add the Señorita brand. If permitted by law and consistent with Nasdaq standards, Rythm will have exclusive rights to commercialize Señorita outside state-regulated dispensaries, while GTI Core remains limited to dispensary channels. In exchange, base licensing fees under the prior agreement increase by $250,000 per year, with other terms unchanged.
